title: Hasliyon Waale Mere
body:
haye ali asgharam haye ali asgharam
<<DIVIDER>>
hasliyon waale mere ho chuke bas ab khafa
haye ali asgharam haye ali asgharam
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein tum kho gaye jaa ke kahan so gaye
maut ko apna liya mujhse khafa ho gaye
kya meri aaghosh se bad ke hai teer e qaza
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ke andhere bhi ab poori tarha cha chuke
dekh parinde sabhi laut ke ghar jaa chuke
baat meri maan le laal mere laut aa
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola bhi khamosh hai qabr bhi veeran hai
aaj se bistar tera khaak e biyaban hai
socha tha kya kya magar haye ye kya hogaya
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ye mai kaise sahun bin tere zinda rahun
tu hi batade mujhe bibiyon se kya kahun
poochti hai mujhse sab chand kahan hai tera
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola jhulaungi mai lori sunaungi mai
apne jigar band dil ko mein chipaungi mai
kehti hai ro ro ke ye kab se meri maamta
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
phool se lab khol de pyar se has bol de
phir mere ehsaas ke kaano mein ras ghol de
aa bhi jaa acha nahi dayr talak roothna
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunti hoon lipte ho tum khoon bhari poshak mein
neend nahi aayegi pairahan e khaak mein
zakhm dhula doon tere kurta badal doon tera
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
rooth gaya aasman hogayi dushman zameen
kisko mai apna kahun hai bhi to koi nahi
ujdi hui godh par tu hi taras kha zara
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair huwe jaate hai aamir o nayyar ke haal
hai teri dargaah mein dono sarapa sawaal
maa teri qurban ho inki tu sunle dua
hasliyon waale mere...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
